release_notes:
• Smoother Live TV: Upgraded buffering engine, faster channel recovery, subtle loading status pill, and 6s offline detection.
• Enhanced Movies & Series: Faster series episode loading, improved subtitle search (OpenSubtitles-first with automatic fallback), and smarter Auto Sync.
• Live TV Recording & TV Box Compatibility: Unified TV-mode detection for Android TV boxes plus cleaner playback controls.
• Sports Replay & Easy Renewal: Improved Sports Replay layout, in-app updates, and renewal requests.
